rulesTestNames: lets a guest get and list only their own contact permissions
owner: messaging contact permission writer, called in the same transaction by every consent writer
read: server only; no client and no organiser reads receipts
write: server only and append-only: created by the consent writer that records the decision
migrationNotes: Issue #2460. The one receipt log for contact consent: it replaced catchCommunicationPermissionReceipts and organizerCommunicationPermissionReceipts and keeps their ids. Account deletion deletes a person's receipts; whether to keep them anonymised instead awaits counsel (OQ-C2).

Issue #2494 phase 2 step 1. Event receipts (senderKind event) join the log: each event-day channel decision keeps its eventAssistanceConsentReceipts id and its event-only fields in event, and each approval-notification choice revision writes a phone and an email receipt.
